items.title_en: How Jack McCall Murdered Wild Bill Hickok, One Of The Most Legendary Lawmen Of The Old West
items.title_zh: 杰克·麦考尔如何谋杀狂野的比尔·希科克，旧西部最传奇的执法者之一
items.summary_en: Public Domain Jack McCall, the little-known drifter who fatally shot Wild Bill Hickok in 1876. On Aug. 2, 1876, Jack McCall walked into a Deadwood saloon, approached Wild Bill Hickok from behind, and shot him in the back of the head. Hickok died instantly, and McCall was arrested for murder.
items.summary_zh: 公共领域 杰克·麦考尔 (Jack McCall)，一位鲜为人知的漂流者，于 1876 年射杀了狂野比尔·希科克 (Wild Bill Hickok)。1876 年 8 月 2 日，杰克·麦考尔 (Jack McCall) 走进戴德伍德的一家酒吧，从后面接近狂野比尔·希科克 (Wild Bill Hickok)，朝他的后脑勺开了一枪。希科克当场死亡，麦考尔因谋杀罪被捕。

items.title_en: Horrifying simulation shows treadmill torture method that was banned from British prisons for being too brutal

items.summary_en: Ask someone what pops into their head when you mention the word 'treadmill' and they'll probably think of the cardio machine in most gyms around the world. But did you know the treadmill actually originated as a labour device used to punish prisoners ? Invented by Victorian engineer Sir William Cubitt in 1818, the treadmill - or everlasting staircase as it was known then - was designed as a way to punish inmates by subjecting them to hours of hard labour. That's right, the exercise machine that very much feels…
items.summary_zh: 如果你问别人，当你提到“跑步机”这个词时，他们的脑海中浮现出什么，他们可能会想到世界上大多数健身房里的有氧运动器械。但你知道跑步机实际上起源于一种用来惩罚囚犯的劳动器具吗？跑步机（当时称为“永久楼梯”）由维多利亚时代的工程师威廉·库比特爵士 (Sir William Cubitt) 于 1818 年发明，其设计初衷是让囚犯进行数小时的苦役来惩罚他们。没错，就是前任
